text: On weekdays I get about six or seven hours, which is honestly a bit less than I need. At weekends I try to catch up and sleep for nine, but I've read that it doesn't really work like that, so I'm trying to go to bed earlier during the week instead.

tips.en: Two situations instead of one number make the answer fuller.
tips.kk: Бір сан орнына екі жағдай — жауап толық шығады.
tips.ru: Две ситуации вместо одной цифры — ответ получается развёрнутым.
tips.example: At weekends I try to catch up and sleep for nine

tips.en: Honestly and a bit less than I need add a personal view.
tips.kk: Honestly және a bit less than I need жеке көзқарас қосады.
tips.ru: Honestly и a bit less than I need добавляют личное отношение.
tips.example: which is honestly a bit less than I need

note.en: Here: get the sleep you missed.

questions.question: How many hours do you usually sleep?

text: Hardly ever, to be honest. If I nap for more than twenty minutes, I wake up feeling groggy and can't concentrate for the rest of the afternoon. My grandfather, on the other hand, has a short nap after lunch every single day and swears it's the secret to his energy.

tips.en: Not just “no” but what happens after a nap.
tips.kk: Жай «жоқ» емес, күндізгі ұйқыдан кейін не болатыны.
tips.ru: Не просто «нет», а что происходит после сна днём.

tips.en: On the other hand brings in an opposite example and makes the answer more interesting.
tips.kk: On the other hand қарама-қарсы мысалды енгізеді — жауап қызықтырақ болады.
tips.ru: On the other hand вводит противоположный пример — ответ становится интереснее.
tips.example: My grandfather, on the other hand

note.kk: «Құпиясы осында деп ант етеді» — толық сенімді.
note.ru: «Клянётся, что в этом секрет…» — уверен на все сто.

questions.followUp: Is napping common in your country?
questions.question: Do you ever take a nap during the day?

text: The worst thing I can do is pick up my phone, because then I'm awake for another hour. What usually works for me is reading something a bit dull, or listening to a podcast with a timer on. If that fails, I get up, make some herbal tea and try again later.

tips.en: First a mistake, then a method that works — a logical order.
tips.kk: Алдымен қате, сосын тиімді тәсіл — логикалық рет.
tips.ru: Сначала ошибка, потом рабочий способ — логичный порядок.
tips.example: The worst thing I can do is pick up my phone

tips.en: If that fails adds a back-up option, so the answer is fully developed.
tips.kk: If that fails қосалқы нұсқаны қосады — жауап соңына дейін дамыған.
tips.ru: If that fails добавляет запасной вариант — ответ развит до конца.
tips.example: If that fails, I get up

questions.followUp: Do you ever read before bed?
questions.question: What do you do if you can't fall asleep?

text: Definitely. My parents were quite strict about bedtime, so on school nights I had to be in bed by nine, even in summer when it was still light outside. I used to hate it at the time, but now I'd give anything for that much sleep.

tips.en: An exact time and the summer light make the memory vivid.
tips.kk: Нақты уақыт пен жазғы жарық естелікті жанды етеді.
tips.ru: Точное время и летний свет делают воспоминание живым.
tips.example: even in summer when it was still light outside

tips.en: Used to and but now give a natural contrast between past and present.
tips.kk: Used to және but now — өткен мен қазірдің табиғи салыстыруы.
tips.ru: Used to и but now — естественный контраст прошлого и настоящего.
tips.example: I used to hate it at the time, but now

note.en: “Had firm rules about when to sleep”.

questions.followUp: What time did you go to bed then?
questions.question: Did you sleep more when you were a child?

text: Generally, no, and I think technology is largely to blame. Most people scroll through their phones in bed, and the light keeps them awake longer than they realise. On top of that, a lot of students and office workers are under so much pressure that sleep is the first thing they sacrifice.

tips.en: The view comes first, with the main cause in the same sentence.
tips.kk: Ұстаным бірден, негізгі себеп — сол сөйлемде.
tips.ru: Позиция сразу, главная причина — в той же фразе.

tips.en: On top of that adds another reason.
tips.kk: On top of that тағы бір дәлел қосады.
tips.ru: On top of that добавляет ещё один довод.
tips.example: On top of that, a lot of students and office workers are under so much pressure

questions.question: Do you think people get enough sleep these days?
